title.zh: Porting my 1993 Amiga game to Godot, with an LLM reading the 68000 assembly
title.en: Porting my 1993 Amiga game to Godot, with an LLM reading the 68000 assembly

current_state.zh: A developer details how he ported his 1993 Amiga game written in MC68000 assembly to Godot in an evening using an LLM that read the original binaries, achieving byte-identical assembly output as a validation step.
current_state.en: A developer details how he ported his 1993 Amiga game written in MC68000 assembly to Godot in an evening using an LLM that read the original binaries, achieving byte-identical assembly output as a validation step.
